subject: gk
question: What is a "maiden over" in cricket?

options.text: An over with no runs scored by the batsman
An over bowled by a spin bowler
An over where the bowler takes a wicket

solution:
The correct answer is __**An over with no runs scored by the batsman**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Innings:** This refers to the period during which a team or player bats. In Test matches, each team has two innings, while in limited-overs formats, each team has one.
 
• **Wicket: **This term has dual meanings: it can refer to the set of three stumps and two bails at either end of the pitch or to the dismissal of a batsman (e.g., "He took five wickets in the match").
